title: Dráček, který neuměl foukat oheň
title_en: The Little Dragon Who Couldn't Breathe Fire
desc: Pip místo ohně fouká bubliny. Ostatní se smějí — dokud bubliny nezachrání vesnici.
desc_en: Pip blows bubbles instead of fire. The others laugh, until the bubbles save the village.
world: a sunny fairy-tale valley with green hills, a small village of round houses and a mossy rock dragon school
setting: Slunné pohádkové údolí se zelenými kopci, vesnicí kulatých domků a dračí školou na mechové skále.
music: whimsical fairy tale children's music, flute, harp and soft marimba, curious and warm, instrumental, 95 bpm

pip.name: dráček Pip
pip.desc: a small chubby green baby dragon standing upright on two legs, big round yellow eyes, tiny orange wings, a pale yellow belly and a short curly tail
pip.look: Malý baculatý zelený dráček, stojí na zadních, má velké žluté oči, oranžová křidélka, světlé bříško a zatočený ocásek.

owl.name: sova Hedvika
owl.desc: a wise round brown owl with big golden eyes, small round glasses and a tiny blue scarf
owl.look: Moudrá kulatá hnědá sova se zlatýma očima, kulatými brýlemi a modrou šálou.

shots.action: Pip sedí v první lavici dračí školy na kopci, za ním stojí řada velkých draků. Rozhlíží se a vrtí ocáskem.
shots.keyframe: Pip the little dragon sits on the front bench of a dragon school class on a green hill, big dragons stand in a row behind him
shots.motion: Pip looks around the class with big curious eyes, wiggles his tail and then sits still
shots.narration: V dračí škole se učilo foukat oheň.
shots.narration_en: At dragon school, everyone learned to breathe fire.

shots.action: Velcí draci chrlí do nebe dlouhé plameny. Pip je pozoruje s otevřenou pusou.
shots.keyframe: a row of big dragons breathe long flames into the sky while Pip the little dragon watches from the side
shots.motion: the big dragons blow long orange flames into the sky, Pip watches them with his mouth open
shots.narration_en: The big dragons blew long, hot flames.

shots.action: Pip stojí na plochém kameni, zhluboka se nadechne a nafoukne tváře. Zafouká a z pusy mu vyletí spousta lesklých mýdlových bublin. Překvapeně otevře oči.
shots.keyframe: Pip the little dragon stands on a flat rock, cheeks puffed, taking a deep breath
motion: Pip takes a big deep breath, his cheeks puff up round and he squeezes his eyes shut
Pip blows hard and many shiny soap bubbles float out of his mouth and up into the air, he opens his eyes, surprised
shots.narration: Pip se nadechl, zafoukal… a místo ohně vyletěly bubliny!
shots.narration_en: Pip took a deep breath, blew… and out came bubbles!

shots.action: Pip stojí mezi poletujícími bublinami, červená se a schovává obličej za křidélka.
shots.keyframe: Pip the little dragon stands among floating soap bubbles, blushing and looking down at his feet
shots.motion: bubbles float around Pip, he blushes, lowers his head and hides his face behind his little wings
shots.narration: Ostatní draci se smáli. Pip se styděl.
shots.narration_en: The other dragons laughed. Pip felt shy.

shots.action: Při západu slunce sedí Pip sám na mechovém kameni u lesa. Povzdechne si a skane mu slza.
shots.keyframe: Pip the little dragon sits alone on a big mossy rock at the edge of a forest at sunset, looking sad
shots.motion: Pip sits on the rock and sighs, his shoulders drop, a small tear rolls down his cheek, then he stays still
shots.narration: Sedl si na kámen a byl smutný.
shots.narration_en: He sat on a rock, feeling sad.

shots.action: Na větev vedle Pipa přiletí sova Hedvika a zvědavě nakloní hlavu.
shots.keyframe: Hedwig the owl lands on a branch next to Pip the little dragon sitting on the mossy rock
shots.motion: the owl flaps her wings, lands on the branch next to Pip and tilts her head at him
shots.narration_en: Hedwig the wise owl flew down.

shots.action: Sova Pipovi vlídně něco vysvětluje a ukazuje křídlem. Mezi nimi pluje bublina, Pip zvedne hlavu a usměje se.
shots.keyframe: Hedwig the owl talks gently to Pip the little dragon, a shiny soap bubble floats between them
motion: the owl talks and gestures with one wing, Pip listens and slowly lifts his head
a shiny bubble floats between them, Pip looks at it and a small smile appears on his face
shots.narration: Každý umí něco jiného, řekla sova. Tvoje bubliny jsou kouzelné.
shots.narration_en: Everyone has a different gift, said the owl. Your bubbles are magic.

shots.action: Na návsi odlétají z ohně velké jiskry k seníku. Pip přiběhne a vyděšeně se zastaví.
shots.keyframe: in the village square a bonfire throws big sparks towards a haystack, Pip the little dragon runs in
shots.motion: sparks fly from the bonfire towards the haystack, Pip runs in, stops and looks worried
shots.narration: Ve vesnici létaly jiskry k seníku!
shots.narration_en: In the village, sparks flew toward the haystack!

shots.action: Pip fouká velké bubliny, jiskry se v nich chytají a s tichým puknutím zhasínají.
shots.keyframe: Pip the little dragon blows a stream of big soap bubbles that catch the flying sparks next to the haystack
shots.motion: Pip blows many big bubbles, the sparks land in the bubbles and go out with a tiny pop, then the air is calm
shots.narration: Pip foukl bubliny a ty jiskry pochytaly.
shots.narration_en: Pip blew bubbles and they caught every spark.

shots.action: Děti ze vsi tleskají a skáčou kolem Pipa. Pip se nesměle usmívá a mává.
shots.keyframe: village children cheer and clap around Pip the little dragon in the village square
shots.motion: the children clap and jump around Pip, Pip smiles shyly and waves at them
shots.narration_en: The children cheered. Pip saved the village!

shots.action: Pip tančí na návsi sambu mezi poletujícími bublinami.
shots.keyframe: Pip the little dragon stands in the village square surrounded by floating bubbles, happy, ready to dance
shots.motion: Pip dances samba on the spot, stepping quickly and swaying his hips, arms moving, bubbles floating around him, same village square
shots.narration_en: Full of joy, he danced a samba among the bubbles.

shots.action: Pod hvězdnou oblohou spí Pip stočený na mechovém kameni. Z nosu mu vyletí poslední bublinka a odpluje.
shots.keyframe: Pip the little dragon sleeps curled up on the mossy rock under a starry night sky, one last bubble floating above him
shots.motion: Pip breathes slowly in his sleep, a small bubble floats up from his nose and drifts away
shots.narration: Večer usnul s úsměvem. Dobrou noc, Pipe.
shots.narration_en: That night he fell asleep smiling. Good night, Pip.
